deletion.ownerQuestion: Are you the owner of this node?
deletion.ownerOnly: Only the owner can manage this node and request its removal from the map.
deletion.captchaPrompt: A quick check to confirm you're not a bot.
deletion.ready: Open the prepared email, check that its contents are correct, then send it. Each request is reviewed individually. It is also helpful to include the reason for removal.

mail.ownershipConfirmation: I CONFIRM THAT I OWN ALL NODES LISTED ABOVE AND REQUEST THEIR REMOVAL FROM THE MESHCORE MAP DATABASE. I HAVE CHECKED THE PUBLIC KEYS OR MESHCORE LINKS AND CONFIRM THAT THIS REQUEST COVERS ONLY THE NODES I INTEND TO REMOVE.
mail.instructions: Check that the public key above belongs to the node you want to remove. Only request removal of nodes you own. To remove several of your nodes, add their public keys or MeshCore contact links (meshcore://contact/add?...), one per line, and send a single request. Full public keys are sufficient; names and screenshots are not needed. You may add a brief reason for removal in English. Keep the subject, removal request and ownership confirmation in English so the recipient can review your request. Opening the email does not submit the request or remove the node from the map.

banner.title: Invitation to test the app
banner.text: We are looking for testers of the MeshCore Map Android app. It is coming to Google Play soon. Join the test and help us polish it.

testers.title: Become an app tester
testers.intro: We are working on the MeshCore Map Android app with a native map. It also works offline: saved node data and previously viewed parts of the map are available without internet. It also includes terrain and coverage analysis and route measuring. Before the app can be published on Google Play, Google requires a closed test with at least 12 people for 14 days.
testers.how: Sign up with the email address of the Google account you use in the Play Store. We will add you to the tester list and send you an install link. The test lasts 14 days; all you need to do is stay in it and open the app from time to time. Feedback is welcome: if something does not work or you have an idea, let us know.
testers.consent: I agree to the processing of my email address to add me to the closed test and to contact me about it. The address will be deleted once testing ends. I can ask for its removal at any time.
testers.success: Thank you very much! Your address has been saved. We will get back to you soon, so keep an eye out for an e-mail.

baseMapInfo.CartoDB Dark: Dark street map from CARTO. Needs an API key; the free tier covers non-commercial use up to 5 million tile requests a month, shared by all of a customer's keys.
baseMapInfo.CartoDB Positron: Light, minimalist street map from CARTO. Needs an API key; the free tier covers non-commercial use up to 5 million tile requests a month, shared by all of a customer's keys.
baseMapInfo.OpenStreetMap: Standard OpenStreetMap map from the official tile server. A best-effort service for interactive viewing: no bulk downloads or prefetching, and heavy use may be blocked.
baseMapInfo.Esri Hybrid: Esri satellite imagery with boundaries and place labels overlaid. Needs an ArcGIS API key (free monthly tier). Esri's terms do not allow storing its map data, so it is meant for online use.
baseMapInfo.OpenTopoMap: Topographic map served by a community server with limited bandwidth. Avoid generating heavy traffic.
baseMapInfo.MapTiler Outdoor: MapTiler outdoor map with roads, trails and topographic information. Requires an API key. The free plan is for non-commercial use, has a monthly quota and allows only temporary caching.
baseMapInfo.MapTiler Hybrid: MapTiler satellite imagery with boundaries and local place labels overlaid. Requires an API key. The free plan is for non-commercial use, has a monthly quota and allows only temporary caching.
baseMapInfo.CyclOSM: Cycling map based on OpenStreetMap data. Uses the openstreetmap.fr community server, so keep traffic moderate.
baseMapInfo.Humanitarian OSM: OpenStreetMap style developed by HOT for humanitarian work. Uses the openstreetmap.fr community server, so keep traffic moderate.
baseMapInfo.OpenFreeMap: Vector street map rendered by MapLibre. Free, requires no API key and has no stated request limit. Requires WebGL support and may use more device resources.
